RF-002 judge: Step 1 missing assertion for initial Email and Phone values: Test case step 1 expects verification that 'Contact detail page shows the initial Email and Phone values that were set during test data creation'. The generated test only verifies the record title (LastName) via expectRecordTitle, but has no assertions for the initial Email and Phone field values displayed on the Contact detail page.

RF-003 judge: Step 3 assertion weaker than expected result: Test case step 3 expects: 'Two ContactHistory records exist: one for Email change showing the previous and new Email values, and one for Phone change showing the previous and new Phone values, each with CreatedById matching the tester and recent CreatedDate'. The generated test only asserts that historyFields() returns an array containing 'Email' and 'Phone' field names. It does not verify: (a) exactly two history records exist, (b) OldValue and NewValue match the specific previous and new values for each field, (c) CreatedById matches the tester, (d) CreatedDate is recent.

RF-004 judge: Step 4 missing assertion for Field History related list content: Test case step 4 expects: 'Field History related list shows two entries: one documenting the Email change with old and new values, and one documenting the Phone change with old and new values, each with correct timestamp and user'. The generated test only opens the Contact record page and calls recordIdFromView, with zero assertions about the Field History related list contents.

RF-003 judge: Missing UI assertion for Account Name on Contact detail page: Step 4 expects 'Contact detail page opens showing Account Name = Acme Test' but the test only verifies the AccountId via SOQL. No assertion checks the Account Name is displayed on the Contact detail page UI.

RF-007 judge: Missing assertions for Title field value on Contact detail page: Steps 2-5 each expect 'Contact detail page shows Title X' (Account Executive, Sales Manager, Director, VP Sales), but test only verifies the record title (Last Name) via expectRecordTitle(). No assertion checks that the Title field actually displays the selected value on the detail page or via SOQL.

RF-004 judge: UI verification of Contact detail page values missing: Step 5 expects 'Contact detail page shows the correct Account Name and all entered field values are displayed' but the test only performs SOQL verification of backend values. No UI assertions confirm the detail page displays First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone, Title, and Account Name.

RF-001 judge: Missing assertion for required fields visibility: Step 1 expects 'New Contact modal opens with required fields visible' but the test only asserts the dialog root is visible (twice). No assertion verifies that required fields (Last Name, Email, etc.) are actually visible in the modal.

RF-002 judge: Field error assertion weaker than expected result: Steps 2 and 3 expect 'an inline error appears on the Email field indicating the address format is invalid' but the test only calls expectFieldError() which checks for any field error presence. The assertion does not verify the error message content indicates an invalid email format (e.g., missing @ symbol).

RF-004 judge: Duplicate warning message content not verified: Step 2 expects 'A possible duplicate warning is displayed indicating a Contact with the same Email already exists on this Account' but the test only asserts a generic toast with any non-whitespace text (expectToast(page, /\S/)). The specific duplicate warning message is not verified.

RF-005 judge: Email not verified on Contact detail page after duplicate save: Step 3 expects 'Contact detail page opens showing the entered Last Name Duplicate and Email <EMAIL_3>' but the test only asserts the record title (Last Name). The Email field on the detail page is not checked.

RF-006 judge: Step 5 assertion does not match case expectation for regression verification: Step 5 expects 'Test execution result shows PASS for the duplicate warning scenario, confirming RE_VERIFY status is satisfied' but the test only asserts the contact record page is visible. This does not verify the regression test MTC-009 passes.
RF-001 locator-unresolved: no locator dry-run for this build (offline): locators are unverified

RF-002 judge: Step action does not match test case: Test case step action is 'Review test execution record for MTC-005' (manual review of test execution records in a test management tool). Generated test performs a SOQL poll on Account.QA_Run_Id__c instead. These are completely different actions — the test does not review any test execution record.

RF-003 judge: Expected result not asserted: Expected result: 'Test execution record shows MTC-005 passed; the test confirms Read Only user sees no New button in Contacts related list'. Generated test asserts only that Account.QA_Run_Id__c matches the recipe value. No assertion verifies MTC-005 passed, nor that a Read Only user sees no New button.

RF-004 judge: Persona mismatch: Test case does not specify a persona for this manual review step. Generated test is tagged @persona:system-admin. The test case notes explicitly state the original test incorrectly used system-admin persona for a UI check that contradicted the case action. This regression verification test should not be tied to a UI persona.

RF-005 judge: Test verifies wrong oracle: The test case is a regression verification that MTC-005 (Read Only user cannot create Contact) passed in the current build. The generated test verifies an Account record exists with a specific QA_Run_Id__c — this confirms the recipe data exists, not that MTC-005 passed. The evidence ID SF-219#AC6 references the MTC-005 test execution record, not the Account record.

RF-001 judge: Missing assertion for regression marker MTC-004: Step 2 expects verification that 'Test execution record shows MTC-004 passed for the current build' (regression marker), but the generated test only re-asserts the Contact appears in the related list. The MTC-004 execution record check is not implemented.

RF-003 judge: Step 5 tests contact detail page related list buttons instead of Contact list view row actions: Test case step 5 says 'Tab through Contact list view and verify row actions are keyboard accessible' with expected result 'Contact list view rows and row-level actions (e.g., Edit, Delete) are reachable and operable by keyboard'. The generated test stays on the Contact record page and checks tab order for casesNewButton and opportunitiesNewButton (New buttons in related lists), not a Contact list view page (/lightning/o/Contact/list) with row-level Edit/Delete actions.
